name: Hiyama Tooru's Foster Mother
source: Tooru's foster mother, a very attractive woman with large breasts and also secretly a nymphomaniac pedophile. After she and her husband adopted a young Tooru as their foster son, Tooru's Mother raped Tooru, exploiting the young Tooru's innocence and fear of being abandoned a second time into obediently having sex with her numerous times against his will. When her husband found out about her adultery with Tooru, he harshly beat Tooru up in retribution instead, this unfair punishment traumatized Tooru with a twisted sense of values towards the opposite sex.
